changes.summary: Stop embedding every user in the notification settings page: rule forms now hold only named recipients and search a paged GET /settings/notifications/recipients. Add notifications.RecipientDirectory and core.ModuleOptions.NotificationRecipientGroups to limit who can be picked; NewNotificationRoutingService takes the directory and Recipients is replaced by SearchRecipients/RecipientsByIDs. Rule-named people outside the directory are refused on save and skipped on delivery. Give navbar controls one 36px round style with even spacing.

Add dual upload storage: new uploads go to the configured primary backend (UPLOAD_STORAGE_BACKEND=fs|s3) while reads route per stored path (s3://<bucket>/<key> from a private S3-compatible bucket, other paths from the filesystem); add streaming UploadService.OpenReader, PresignGetURL and an authenticated GET /uploads/{id} download route. Compositions without a config Source must now also provide *uploadsconfig.StorageConfig.
